_comment: Insight nodes triggered by examining the world. Every examinable surface in the game fires an insight node when examined for the first time -- per the locked authoring doctrine (docs/design/insight_revelation_system.md *Authoring guide*). These nodes (a) promote language-map entries on the examined thing itself, and (b) unlock Guide-side dialog topics where the Guide names what the Vagrant has seen.

knows_dissolved_souls._comment: Fires on first examine of the acheron_pile (static mesh). Promotes the pile's own label + body text by one tier; unlocks a Guide-side reveal topic.

knows_arrival_queue._comment: Fires on first examine of a larva_fresh actor (fresh larva in the queue, crawling, hasn't reached a corpse to feed). Promotes the actor's tier-0 examine prose to a tier-1 reveal; unlocks a Guide-side reveal topic on the arrival-queue cosmology.

knows_feeding_cycle._comment: Fires on first examine of a larva_aged_feeder actor (aged larva mid-feed on a second-deathed corpse). Promotes the feeder's tier-0 examine prose to a tier-1 reveal; unlocks a Guide-side reveal topic on the feeding-cycle cosmology.
